headline: Lock-strafe 1.2.1 fixes stopping, flips and fixed-camera behaviour
summary: Lock-strafe 1.2.1 is released with movement fixes (#164). Ratchet follows the stick without a forward push when strafing stops, flips go straight, and he faces ahead during running and double jumps. Strafing is disabled under a level's fixed camera, including Kalebo III's wall camera, while L2 input is still taken.
highlights: Item-randomizer vendor and Gadgetron PDA crash fixes (#156), plus Archipelago starting options and shuffled gold-weapon cases (#157), were proposed but have not merged.
A native Cheats mod with pause-menu controls is proposed in #163. Multiplayer 0.12.4's proposed stick-navigation fix also remains unmerged (#165).
Bolt Grabber V2, which lets hyper-strikes smash nearby crates and props, is submitted in #159. Its listing pull request #160 awaits review.
Weapon Wheel Pause 1.0.2 (#158) and Restored Debug Menu 1.1.1 (#161) await review before players receive the external mod updates.
The mod-index build failure issue #162 opened and closed as completed. Its report says the last good index stays live when a build fails.
The Archipelago logic play-test issue closes as completed (#25).
